R4.basis: Kreg-corrected cut rows vs board materials (§9)

R5.reason: All base parts are 3.5 x 3.5 (4x4 per §9, the only listed material that matches); 4x4 bought is 2 x 72" = 144" but the corrected cut list needs 192.5" (the steps' own 4 legs at 29.5" + 2 beams at 26" = 170" also exceeds 144").
R5.arithmetic: Kreg-corrected rows: Legs 4 x 29.5 = 118; Base A 1 x 26 = 26; Base B 2 x 24.25 = 48.5; total 192.5" + 1/8" x 6 cuts = 193.25" vs bought 2 x 72 = 144"; short 49.25" (not kerf-only). Quantity 2 is not an importer default of 1.

R6.reason: Sizes in steps (2.5" Kreg soft wood screws, 2" screws) match materials[2],[3]. Fastener for the base joints (steps[6]-[8]) is not stated; recorded in gaps.

evidence.quote: Then, cut 2 trapezoids for the base beams at 26" (on the long edge) with 15 degree angles on each end.

R14.reason: Step 6 makes 2 base beams at 26"; the cut list has Table Base A x1 (26") and Table Base B x2 (24.25" corrected), i.e. 3 pieces at two different lengths. Step 8 then splits only 'the last base piece' into halves ('cut 3.5" out of the very middle').
R14.arithmetic: Step: 2 beams at 26 = 52" of beam. Cut list (Kreg-corrected): 1 x 26 + 2 x 24.25 = 74.5" in 3 pieces. Counts 2 vs 3, and halves of a 26" beam (26 - 3.5)/2 = 11.25 vs 24.25.
